Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":true,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.3}}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extract(input, config);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).detectedLanguages());
    }
}
```
